record.reason: verifier FAIL: value reproduces most of its own evidence window

provenance: M38 cold review, three findings folded into one case because they are one property: the surface must end TERMINAL and USABLE however the run ends, and each defect instead left it asserting something untrue. (1) `es.onerror` polled `GET /tasks/{id}` with no `.catch`, and `renderResult` read `r.status.split(':')` unguarded -- so a run record that 404s (the in-memory `RUNS` after a redeploy, support-matrix D19, or a mid-run restart, D18) threw a TypeError, and `$('go').disabled = false` never ran. (2) The same handler re-enabled submission and rendered against the module-global `runId`, so a late poll for run A built `/runs/<B>/step_N.png` URLs -- run B's screenshots under run A's step captions, no error anywhere. (3) `renderScraped` cut a value at 300 chars with no marker, which on the dominant live failure shape (D27's CONTAINER DUMP, six finance domains) renders a multi-thousand-character page dump as a tidy, well-scoped extraction, hiding the exact defect the run was rejected for. What makes (1) an M38 defect rather than an old one is the spinner this milestone added: the page now ANIMATES the claim that a dead run is in progress. The case drives the real PAGE on the shared `_ui_page` render with `fetch` and `EventSource` stubbed, the same way `ui-form` does, and restores both.

triage.watched_red: against `git show HEAD:src/browser/server.py` served by uvicorn and driven by the same stubs: submit -> stream 500 -> record 404 gives `#status` 'RUNNING' with `go.disabled true` forever and one uncaught pageerror, "Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'split')". Re-run against the fixed page: `#status` 'STREAM LOST', `animationName` 'none', both buttons enabled, `#progress[data-terminal]` 'failure', no pageerror. The clip half was watched red the same way -- a 2000-char value rendered as 300 characters with no ellipsis and no length.
triage.note: Ceiling, declared: this grades the page's handlers against a stubbed transport. A real dropped connection against the real gateway is not exercised by any suite, and the `check` button's server-side twin -- `/smoke/stream` refusing while `SEM` is held -- is graded by nothing here either.
